title: The Output Window
summary: Studio's log: prints, warnings, and every error with script + line number. Open it FIRST when anything misbehaves (View → Output). Errors double-click to jump to the exact line.

explanation.whatItIs: Your console: everything your scripts say (print/warn) and everything the engine complains about lands here.
explanation.whyItExists: Games have no terminal; Output is the shared channel between your code and your eyes.
whenToUse: First stop for ANY bug — read the red lines fully
Double-click errors → jumps to the offending line
Server vs client messages both appear (labels show context in Play Solo/teams tests)
whenNotToUse: For production logging at scale — use the proper logging APIs
As a UI channel for players
tips: View → Output if it's missing; keep it docked while building
warn() prefixes 'WARNING:' and survives log filtering better than print
Stack traces below errors show the call chain — read upward to the FIRST relevant frame
Flooded output? Filter or add conditional prints
commonMistakes: Coding with Output closed — missing every error
Leaving debug spam in shipped games

examples.title: Useful breadcrumbs
examples.code:
print("[Round] starting with", #players, "players")
warn("[Save] retry", attempt, "for", player.UserId)

-- Structured-ish prints beat mystery values:
print("hit:", hit:GetFullName(),
      "humanoid:", hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil)
